name: Generate sentences adhering to specific structural constraints
description: Users requested the generation of specific sentences or short texts by adhering to strict structural constraints, such as mandatory starting or ending words, fixed word counts, required vocabulary lists, or specific grammatical tenses. They also asked for the combination of sentence fragments or bullet points into coherent, logical single sentences.
